title: International Swimming Pool and Spa Code, with the IBC's occupant load
edition: ISPSC 2021: public pools (Chapter 4) as a Texas DSHS checklist cites them, residential pools (Chapter 8) from ICC CodeNotes; IBC 2021 Table 1004.5
notes: Follows the IBC code setting. ICC's free view refused automated reads, so the public-pool values are secondary: check them against the ISPSC text in a browser (research/23 A.18).

pool.description: Floor slope where the water is shallower than 5 ft: 1 ft in 10 ft at most (as the Texas checklist cites it)
Floor slope where the water is 5 ft deep or more: 1 in 3 at most
Residential: the floor from the shallow end to the transition point slopes 1 in 7 at most
Residential: the shallow end is 33 in to 4 ft deep
Public pools: a deck 6 ft wide round the pool
Public pools: two entries and exits, one at each end; accessible-entry devices do not count
A wading pool is 18 in deep at most
Occupant load of a swimming pool: 50 ft² gross of water per occupant (its deck 15 ft²)
